context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard redesign fully tested. Key features: 1) Dashboard Overview at /dashboard shows balance, verification status, contract status, and statistics (garage count, applications, deals, tenders). Consultant help button costs $200. 2) MyGarage at /dashboard/garage shows car cards with 'Add to deal $300' and 'Start tender' buttons. 3) DealCars at /dashboard/deals shows active deals or empty state. 4) Applications at /dashboard/applications shows application list with dialog containing 'Manager help $200' and 'Start tender' buttons. 5) Tenders at /dashboard/tenders shows tender list with offers. Fee constants: DEAL_ADD_FEE=$300, CONSULTANT_FEE=$200.
